# Rises a change makes on purpose: one per line, as
#   <benchmark name prefix> <unit> <most rise> <reason...>
# unit: allocs/op, read-B/op or readcalls/op. A PR that adds a line says
# why in its description; the line goes again once the change is on main.
BenchmarkPlanRotation allocs/op 5 image data guard: the HEIF image extents snapshotted before the edit
BenchmarkSetRotation allocs/op 5 image data guard: the HEIF image extents snapshotted before the edit
BenchmarkPlanVideoEdit allocs/op 14 image data guard: the movie's chunk ranges, from the moov box in memory
BenchmarkPlanVideoRotation allocs/op 17 image data guard: the movie's chunk ranges, from the moov box read once
BenchmarkPlanVideoRotation read-B/op 800 image data guard: the moov box read whole, once, for its chunk tables
